dct_description_sm: Accompanying materials: 3 sheets ; 69 cm. or smaller. Two sheets show cities of Guangping Fu, Zhangde Fu, and Kaifeng Fu, Henan Province. Another sheet shows ill. and notes of animals and wagons used as transportation vehicles and ill. of farm tools.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Each section of road separately titled (drawn on one or two sheets).
Shows road from Beijing to Hankou (present Wuhan). Covers five provinces in Eastern China: Hebei, Shandong, Henan, Anhui, and Hubei.
